text:
maya: flagging a weird rounding delta from today's price-sheet flip (v4-permin) for cohort-A. invoice totals differ by small cents on ~240 accounts. not urgent but noisy on support queue.
ben: curious if it's rounding to nearest cent vs per-invoice rounding. can you share sample invoice id?
maya: sample invoice INV-20260322-1842. support thread: https://support.internal/ticket/9891
liam: quick check: new variant calculates per-minute usage then rounds per-minute, old variant summed raw seconds then rounded on total. that could cause up to ±$0.15 per invoice.
tara: finance: what's exposure? do we auto-credit micro-deltas or only material amounts?
ben: policy is micro-deltas < $1 auto-adjust. confirm counts and total exposure.
maya: ran a query at 07:05 UTC to estimate exposure:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices_affected, SUM(ABS(rounded_total - raw_total)) AS cents_diff
FROM invoice_summaries
WHERE price_variant IN ('v3','v4-permin')
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-22'
  AND region = 'us-west';
```
liam: result: invoices_affected=243, cents_diff=312 (i.e., $3.12 total). median delta $0.01, max $0.47.
tara: that's tiny. approve auto-credit for deltas <= $1 and batch issue a single credit per account. docs: update policy doc after this.
ben: approve. finance asks ops to run cleanup and prepare customer communications template. keep proactive outreach only for >$5.
maya: will schedule cleanup job. plan: 1) compute per-account net delta, 2) issue single credit (sum of deltas) to account, 3) add note on invoice: "rounding adjustment due to per-minute billing experiment".
liam: can we adjust experiment to use per-invoice rounding instead to match legacy behavior? that would avoid churn.
maya: product note: per-minute granularity is intentional for price-sensitivity granularity, but agree rounding rule should be consistent. opening PR to change rounding to per-invoice and to add a flag to toggle during rollouts.
ops-bot: created INF-3400: "billing: rounding-mode toggle + reconcile micro-deltas" assigned to eng-platform. link: https://b.internal/INF-3400
oliver-vendor: vendor note: our metering endpoint reports per-second usage with 6 decimal places. if you request per-minute aggregation we round on our side; we can change to return raw seconds and let you control rounding. happy to coordinate.
tara: vendor, please send proposed change timeline. finance needs a contract appendix if this becomes standard.
oliver-vendor: will propose timeline by EOD.
ben: ops, schedule the batch credit job for 11:30 UTC and include a safe-guard: auto-credit only if net delta <= $1 per account and total batch <= $5k.
sara: (billing ops) queued job FIN-4802. dry-run succeeded. will run at 11:30.
maya: prepping customer note: "We identified minor rounding differences after a pricing experiment. We've applied a small credit where applicable. No action required." template ready.
ben: good. after credits run, please post reconciliation summary and mark the experiment paused if deltas spike.
liam: adding gating step to rollout SOP: "confirm rounding-mode match with legacy before flip". PR created: https://git.internal/pricing/rollout/149
ops-bot: archival reminder: this thread will auto-archive in 90 days.
